audience: developers and DevOps engineers who host apps on Scalingo

useCases.title: Check app status, containers and resource use
useCases.text: The AI lists your apps, shows container types with amount and size, and reads CPU, memory and swap use per container. You see how each app runs.

useCases.title: Review recent deployments and app events
useCases.text: The AI lists an app's deployments with status, git ref and pusher, and its activity events such as scaling and restarts. It helps you find what changed.

useCases.title: Read recent app logs
useCases.text: The AI fetches the last lines of an app's logs as text. It can point out errors or a repeating problem.

useCases.title: Audit domains, addons and collaborators of an app
useCases.text: The AI lists an app's custom domains with TLS status, its addons such as databases, and its collaborators. You can check what is attached to an app.

useCases.title: Restart, scale, set variables or deploy an app
useCases.text: The AI restarts an app, changes the number and size of its containers, sets environment variables in bulk, or triggers a deployment from an archive URL. These actions change live infrastructure.
